meta.purpose: Multi-period operating series for Jack in the Box Inc. (NASDAQ: JACK) from official SEC EDGAR filings. Shows direction across FY2024, FY2025, and Q1 FY2026 rather than a single quarter. Corporate brand health is context only — it does not substitute for private franchisee financials or PARCEL-001 store-level sales.
